name: pantry
description: Household pantry/stock tracker built on the 'Podex' framework: a PowerShell/Pode hypermedia web app with an htmx + Mustache + Tailwind server-rendered frontend and SQLite storage. Currently the repo ships the stock Podex CRUD demo scaffold; the pantry product per .aidd/spec.md is not yet implemented.

server.routing: file-based auto-registration under api/**/*.ps1 (filename -> HTTP method + path)

storage.dataAccessLayer: absent — SQL currently inlined per route handler (spec asks for a small swappable DAL)

deployment.notes: server.psd1 PodeCfg binds HTTP localhost:8433 with HttpsEnabled=$false and no certificate. Static caching disabled. No production/hosting config present.

auth.rationale: No authentication, authorization, sessions, or CSRF protection exist. Spec explicitly states 'No authentication ... single household (no multi-tenancy)'.
concerns: Destructive debug routes (/stop, /clear, /init) are unauthenticated and GET-triggerable, enabled by default via Podex.Debug=$true in server.psd1.

dataSensitivity.rationale: Data is a single household's pantry inventory (item names, categories, quantities, expiry dates, notes). No personal, financial, health, or authentication data is stored.

criticality.rationale: Local single-household hobby/utility app with no availability, revenue, or safety obligations. Not production-facing.
criticality.dataLossTolerance: moderate (SQLite file is recreatable from the seed-data script)

externalIntegrations.rationale: Spec mandates 'no external APIs'. No third-party service calls, webhooks, or outbound network dependencies exist. JS/PowerShell package registries (npm, PSGallery) are build-time only.

commands.install: .build.ps1 (interactive: Install-Module + npm install + optional DB re-init)

validation.recommendedGate: npm run analyze && npm run test
notes: No combined 'smoke:qc' / single verify script exists; PowerShell static analysis (analyze) and Pester tests (test) are the closest project-native gates.
As of the 2026-07-10 codebase analysis: tests/ contains only tests.ps1.old which the Pester glob (tests/*.ps1) excludes, so effective test coverage is 0%.
.build.ps1 conflates install/setup with build and is interactive; it is not a pure non-interactive verify command.
